definitions.full: H6151. arab [ עֲרַב ] verb mix ( ᵑ7 (often); Syriac (rare); see Biblical Hebrew I. ערב ); — Pa`el Passive participle מְעָרַב mixed with ( ב ) Dan 2:41 , 43 . Hithpa. Participle id.: מִתְעָרַב Dan 2:43 ( עִם ), plural רֲבִין - 2:43 ( ב ).
